BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Ryan are delighted to present 11 Radharc Na Coille, Rathcoole, Co. Cork to the market. This impressive four-bedroom, three-bathroom detached family home extends to approximately 160 sq.m. and offers spacious, well-appointed accommodation in the heart of the picturesque village of Rathcoole. Built in approximately 2007 and boasting a B3 BER Rating, the property qualifies for a Green Mortgage, making it an attractive and energy-efficient option for prospective purchasers. Presented to the market vacant and chain free, this is an excellent opportunity for those seeking a straightforward purchase with immediate availability.

Designed with comfortable family living in mind, the property offers bright, generously proportioned accommodation throughout, providing an ideal balance of living and bedroom space. Whether you are a growing family, a first-time buyer seeking additional space, or someone looking to relocate to a peaceful village setting, this home caters to a wide range of purchasers while offering excellent potential to make it your own.

Externally, the property enjoys off-street parking to the front, while the large rear garden provides an excellent outdoor space for families, entertaining or gardening enthusiasts. The garden is further complemented by a practical garden shed, offering valuable additional storage. Oil-fired central heating ensures year-round comfort, while the property's modern construction and efficient BER contribute to economical day-to-day living.

Situated within the welcoming village of Rathcoole, this home enjoys the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of the surrounding countryside with the convenience of village amenities on your doorstep. Ideally positioned just off the Killarney Road, the property offers excellent connectivity to surrounding towns while allowing residents to enjoy a peaceful rural lifestyle in a well-established residential development.

Offering spacious accommodation, an excellent energy rating, vacant possession and a highly desirable location, 11 Radharc Na Coille represents a superb opportunity to acquire a quality detached family home in a charming village setting. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this wonderful property has to offer.

Viewing is strictly by appointment with the sole selling agents, DNG Ryan.
